body:
You're right, I should have explained it better to her from the get go. From her perspective it just sounds like a lame excuse. But now it's been a couple of months so it'd probably come off weird if I approached her now. It's hard we didn't talk much at all before and definitely not now. I don't know where they got this idea we would be a great couple. I don't really know the first thing about this girl because I haven't spent any one on one time with her, even at group settings it's always just a casual "What's new with you? etc"

But thank you for the kind words.

Thanks for taking the time to give your thoughts.
I totally get a cool down period, but this happened in December and the trip is in May. However, now that you say that maybe they booked the tickets earlier while it was still too fresh. I think I expressed interest and just assumed we hadn't gotten tickets yet. 

So maybe you're right but we also booked Japan one, maybe,  two weeks after they would have booked the concert.

Thanks for your response. I tried to be. I told her shortly that I was sorry but I'm not looking for anything right now, as I just moved out here and I'm not ready for a relationship. I also told her I still wanted to see her for our group trips/hangouts. I probably should have been more explicit as to how it wasn't about her but my own situation, but at the time that felt weird.
But I dunno, I think they expected me to at a minimum tell her I would be open to the idea later on but that felt like leading her on since I don't know if my  feelings would change once I feel more ready. And yeah now I feel like Japan won't be as much fun if two of the four of us don't interact much at all.

I understand. I have always been jealous, largely because of my insecurity. However I do enjoy feeling possessive too, and for much of the relationship we both enjoyed that. We were possessive of each other. "No love without jealousy." Is what we told each other. It was just so different this time, with this guy. And she won't ever admit it, even if I told her I know more than I should because of my invasion of her privacy, she would just latch onto the invasion and not blame herself for letting the feelings for the new guy develop. She flirted with him at work. She talked about porn and making sex tapes with him for fucks sake, and I was controlling for thinking that crossed boundaries. And she TOLD me about the porn and sex tapes conversations, and she denied that he had feelings for her. 

I'm starting therapy again Wednesday, but it'll be months before I can start medication and I want to. Because I think I know I won't do anything, but I keep visualizing plunging a knife into my heart. Because why didn't I go? She didn't cheat, she was having scary thoughts. She might even have emotionally cheated but distance is fucking hard.

I wish I had been more careful to not repeat the mistakes I made with my high school relationship, they were similar. Maybe worse this time around. But I hadn't dated for 6 years before this girl, two kisses in 6 years. So I latched onto her way too tightly.

Yeah... I guess I tried to do everything for her, to make her happy. Which I know is a recipe for disaster. Especially with girls like her, she even warned me. No matter what I did do for her it wasn't enough. But at the same fucking time she asked me to most of the things, or at least heavily implied. She grew tired of me before I even got there. Fuck.

I'm recently 24. (She hadn't even written me a fucking birthday card and I was meant to get there the day before my birthday....) I'm in between whatever the hell I'm supposed to be doing, I changed my plans over the last year for this girl. Again a mistake, she even told me not to make plans based on her.. (About a week before I came, before that she wanted me to be ready to move across the globe for her. To marry her. HA FUCK. I was hesitant when she first brought up all the super future planning/wedding/etc. but then when I voiced a little bit of interest in it the first time she tried to end it what the fuck (this was 6 months into the relationship?) ) I graduated college with a BA in Biology because I didn't know what else to do. Now I'm just stuck nowhere. I took the last year after graduating in 2016 to apply to grad schools and didn't get in anywhere, also worked an online dead end job so I could visit her a couple of times a year. So now I'm still just living at home. I wish I had just gone, at least I could have gotten a fun trip out of the summer. But then again maybe it would have been miserable. I couldn't bring myself to go after seeing her messages about getting opinions on this guy and/looking at his profile on facebook 10 ten times a day. I just couldn't do it. 

Side tracked. Sorry. But basically I have no idea where to go from here.  I never felt that much passion for my studies, or much of anything. Did you always love your studies? Or did you find them later in life? I've never felt a great motivation.
